parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(la.code,'8000') AS code,
  COALESCE(la.name,'Omzet NL') AS naam,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.invoice_number) AS aantal,
  COALESCE(SUM(ii.quantity*ii.unit_price),0) AS totaal_excl,
  COALESCE(SUM(ii.btw_amount),0) AS totaal_btw,
  COALESCE(SUM(ii.total),0) AS totaal_incl
FROM invoice_items ii
JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_number=ii.invoice_number
LEFT JOIN ledger_entries le ON le.reference=i.invoice_number AND le.journal='verkoop'
LEFT JOIN ledger_accounts la ON le.account_id=la.id
WHERE i.status='verzonden'
  AND YEAR(i.date)={{ $json.jaar }}
  AND ({{ $json.kwartaal_nr }}=0 OR QUARTER(i.date)={{ $json.kwartaal_nr }})
  AND ({{ $json.maand_nr }}=0 OR MONTH(i.date)={{ $json.maand_nr }})
GROUP BY COALESCE(la.code,'8000'), COALESCE(la.name,'Omzet NL')
UNION ALL SELECT '__geen__','__geen__',0,0,0,0
